svg.title: Axon Central Hub and Spoke Architecture
svg.desc: Comprehensive radial architecture diagram illustrating the central Axon Hub synchronizing skills, workflows, commands, and rules bidirectionally with a remote Git repository and fanning out via native symlinks to modern AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, Antigravity, Codex, Qoder, and custom agents.

g.text: CENTRAL HUB · SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
